text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After class, I spot Эйшин Флэш and Daiwa<n>Scarlet
in front of the school building.<n>They seem
perturbed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nooo... It looks like it's about to rain any<n>second,
Flash.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
This is concerning. If we go looking for<n>umbrellas
now, we'll be late by more<n>than five minutes.
choice_data_list: You can use this umbrella if you like.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your generous offer... but<n>won't you
get soaked by the rain<n>instead?
choice_data_list: I've got a folding umbrella with me too.
I've got a folding umbrella with me too.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Then I suppose I have no reason to<n>refuse. Thank
you for this.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
If you're free, would you like to come<n>along and
watch the tryouts with us?

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have an important matter<n>scheduled for
today. Come, let's go to<n>the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh no! It started raining!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Move in closer, Scarlet. Otherwise your<n>shoulder
will get wet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Sharing an umbrella like this<n>feels a little
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, your shoulder is still protruding<n>beyond
the umbrella by three<n>centimeters. Please come
closer to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: O-okay... Ahaha... Is it hot today or is it<n>just me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them draw close under the<n>umbrella
and begin stepping in unison.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
The rain has eased up. Thank goodness<n>it was
only a passing shower.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah! The race is about to start, Flash!
choice_data_list:
So, what was that important matter you
mentioned?

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
One of the younger students that Scarlet<n>and I
have grown close to is competing<n>in today's
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text: She's quite dear to us, so we came to<n>support her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'll be okay... Do you think<n>she's
nervous?!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
The only thing we can do at this point is<n>cheer her
on. Let's have faith in her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This is it!
Do your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even beneath the overcast sky, the<n>atmosphere is
crackling with energy.<n>Sparks fly as the talented
young racers<n>bolt down the turf.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Work those legs! Focus on your lap time!<n>Maintain
your pace!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Stay aware of your surroundings! Come<n>on! Don't
give in! Run with all you've<n>got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racer they're cheering for reaches<n>the front of
the pack early on and<n>maintains a steady pace
throughout.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And in the end...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hooray! She did it! She won!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic! She was amazing! That race<n>played out
perfectly for her!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Woo! She really pulled it off! This calls<n>for a
celebration!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Эйшин Флэш and Daiwa Scarlet are so<n>overjoyed
it's as if they won the race<n>themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense an irreplaceable bond in the<n>feelings they
share for the young<n>Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Thank you! However, those<n>words would
be better directed at our<n>young victor.
choice_data_list: Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Let's arrange a big celebration for today.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Thank you! However, those<n>words would
be better directed at our<n>young victor.
choice_data_list: Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Looks like you've got yourself a new rival!
Let's arrange a big celebration for today.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
So it seems. We'll have to stay on our<n>toes once
she has a trainer of her own.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I won't lose! Not to her, or to you, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right. I'll have to cook up all<n>of her
favorite food.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll help out, too! Oh, why don't we bake<n>a cake
together? I'm sure she'd love it!

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I look forward to the day we can<n>all race
together on the track.

text_block_list.name: Эйшин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Let's bake the most delicious treat<n>we
possibly can.
